If users can reach their first useful interaction with fewer steps, they’ll be more likely to complete onboarding and return.

If every tap gives immediate, clear feedback, users will move with more confidence and reach value faster.

Expanding Design system for Glasses UI
Mentra       UIUX Design Guidelines 2025
Iconography Overview - Mentra OS 2.0
Best Practice
—Create a 24x24px artboard for each icon.
—Add 3px padding to 24x24px artboard.
—Set up your workspace to snap to pixels and round values to whole pixels to avoid corrections later.
—Use the rectangle tool instead of the line tool to avoid placing vectors on half pixels.
—Be mindful of automatic alignments, which can result in vectors on uneven or half pixels.
—Flatten and merge all pixel units for better resizing.
—Properly name layers and artboards.
—Create a component for each new icon. 
Framework & Key-shapes
Base grid  24x24px
For uniformity, the Mentra icons are crafted on top of a foundational 24x24px grid. It is advised to employ this grid while designing icons to ensure a cohesive and practical visual presentation.
Padding  3px (Are allowed to be broken if necessary)
Unit
Pixels Unit
Use a 1x1px unit to draw the icon, as this gives the best consistency across all icons.
Pixel unit
1x1 px
Do
don't
Icon should remain inside the padding.
Extend icons into padding if additional space is needed.
Some icons are allowed to use a 2-pixel stroke.

Pixel corner characteristics.
Avoid placing the pixel unit on random decimals.
Avoid placing the majority part of the icon in the padding area.
Avoid over complicating the icons. Keep them simple and focused.
Avoid using smooth rounded corners for a corner effect; opt for pixelated corners instead.
